title: Role
description:
A Role is the product-layer projection of an Operational Role AND the RBAC role consumed by product/api auth middleware and product/ui permission guards. Like every Product Core primitive it is DERIVED, never hand-authored — the product-core-materializer projects it from the operational People primitives and access Rules.

The `role` mapping names the Operational Role it projects (defaults to `name`). `permissions[]` is a denormalized rollup materialized from the Operational access Rules that name this role — a convenience so guards need not re-traverse the rule graph, NOT a new source of truth.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the role.

role.description: The Operational Role this product role projects. Defaults to matching `name` when omitted.

scope.description: The Group or Person within which the role is exercised, mirroring the Operational Role scope.

permissions.description: Derived rollup of the Product Core operations/actions this role may perform, materialized from the Operational access Rules that name the role. A denormalized convenience, not an authored ACL.
